Applicant/Appellant:
 Sreeraj, Aged 21 Years,
 S/O Thankarajan, Pulikuzhimele Puthen Veedu (H),
 Cherinjam Konam, Neyyardam, Mukunthara Desom,
 Kallikkadu Village, Thiruvananthapuram District, Pin - 695524.

 State Of Kerala
 Represented By Public Prosecutor,
 High Court Of Kerala,
 Ernakulam,Pin - 682031.

Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the
High Court be pleased to issue an interim order suspending the execution
of the sentence imposed on the petitioner in S.C.No.2929/2022 of the Fast
Track Special Court, Kattakada, ordering his release on bail, pending
final disposal of the above Criminal Apeal.
 This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application
and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.B.Muhammed Shaheel, Jyothi R. Nair,
Feba Mary Thomas, Keerthi Vijayan, Advocates for the applicant and of the
Public Prosecutor for the respondent, the court passed the following:
 P.T.O.
 C.S.Sudha, J.
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 Crl.M.Appl. No.1 of 2024
 in
 Crl. Appeal No.2292 of 2024
 ---------------------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 9th day of January 2025
 Order

This application under Section 430(1) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, has been filed seeking suspension of sentence of the applicant/accused in S.C.No.2929/2022 on the file of the Sreeraj vs State Of Kerala on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130420687/
1 Court of Session, Thiruvananthapuram.

He has been found guilty of the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 354(A)(1)(i), 376, (1) of IPC and Sections 3(a) read with Section 4, 9(l) read with Section 10, 11(iv) read with Section 12 of the PoCSO Act.
He has been sentenced to varying terms of imprisonment for the aforesaid offences.
The sentences have been directed to run concurrently.
The maximum period of imprisonment he will have to undergo is 10 years.
2. The learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits in that the testimony of PW1, the victim would show that she and the accused were in a relationship for several years.
It is also pointed out that at the time of the incident, the victim girl was 16 years and 10 months old and the applicant/accused was only 19 years old.
Hence it is submitted that a lenient view may be taken and the sentence may be suspended.
3. The application is opposed by the learned public prosecutor who submits that even if relationship was consensual, the victim girl being a minor, the offence of rape is made out.
4. Heard both sides.
5. I was taken through the impugned judgment as well as the testimony of PW1.
It is seen that the applicant/accused had infact moved a habeas Corpus petition alleging that PW1 was in the unlawful custody of her parents.
By the time the said case was taken up for consideration, the marriage of PW1 was solemnized with another person.
The applicant/accused in was only 19 years old at the time of the incident.
It is true that at the time of the incident, the victim was only a minor and hence technically the offence of rape is made out.
